agenticSection.label: Agentic Engineering
agenticSection.intro: Architect and operate custom AI agent systems on Claude Code that automate the software lifecycle end to end, turning a single requirement into shipped, reviewed, and documented production code.

bullets.text: Autonomous delivery pipeline (/dev-loop): Designed an agent workflow that takes one requirement (a Slack thread, PRD, or Jira key) and drives it through triage, ticketing, code generation, a hard definition-of-done gate (automated codebase-standards audit, code review, and tests), and stakeholder documentation.

One-prompt store releases (Fastlane): Automated the entire release with custom Fastlane lanes for iOS and Android, so a single prompt (for example, "Add builds 1.4.0") builds, signs, and ships the app to both the App Store and Google Play in one pass, guarded by an automated static-analysis and test gate.

MCP platform integrations: Extended the agent runtime with MCP servers for Jira, Confluence, Slack, and Figma, so agents autonomously manage tickets, publish documentation, and pull live design and project context.

Multi-agent orchestration (BMad method): Plan, build, and review complex features with a coordinated set of analyst, architect, PM, dev, and reviewer agents, using adversarial verification and scheduled agent loops to hold quality and consistency high.

Design-to-spec workflow (/design-spec): Turns a Figma link or screenshots into production-ready deliverables (a Figma-to-code mapping, a PRD, and a pixel-accurate interactive prototype) governed by a codified design system.
Led architectural design and deployment of production-grade Flutter and KMP applications, plus supporting full-stack services, for international healthcare and enterprise markets.
